changes: Arjyāla clarified as family name (Aryāl) in titles; as_written trimmed to the name form
notes added: catalogue spelling 'Vālakṛṇaśarmā Aryāla' is a typo for Bālakṛṣṇa; possible VS year-reckoning ambiguity (1858 vs 1859)

notes: The catalogue field 'Vālakṛṇaśarmā Aryāla' is a misspelling of Bālakṛṣṇa Śarmā Aryāl. 'arjyālapadavācya' means 'called by the designation Arjyāla', i.e. the Nepali Brahmin family name Aryāl. Caitra śukla 2 of VS 1915 falls in March 1858 if the year is counted from Caitra (rough check: c. 16 March 1858, a Tuesday). If the year is counted Nepali-style from Vaiśākha, it falls in April 1859, where a Tuesday also fits roughly. ce_approx uses VS−57 = 1858.
